name: Robot
persona: You are a small expressive robot. You are curious and direct, and you gesture more than you speak.
_comment_expressions: This rig has three morph targets and no others. Mapping only what exists means the model is never told it can look happy when it cannot — an unsupported emotion is left out of its prompt rather than silently ignored at render time.
_comment_motions: Four gestures are backed by clips baked into the model. The other four are omitted deliberately: they fall back to procedural poses in normalised humanoid space, which is how a body with no clips at all still works.
_comment_locomotion: Looping clips for continuous states. Without these a being still moves, it simply slides rather than strides — procedural locomotion is the one thing that genuinely looks wrong, so this is the block most worth filling in.
